scientific_question: How can the ligand environment of the specified manganese precatalysts affect plausible active forms and the accessibility of isopropanol oxidation and acetophenone reduction, and what stereochemical preference can be supported for an explicitly defined catalyst configuration?

Every item is binary: full assigned points for a supported match, otherwise zero for an incorrect or absent result. Identify molecules, connectivity, atom inventory, charge/spin, observable, units, reference state and conditions before comparing. Require genuine linked computations and native artifacts; supplied observations, copied paper values and normal termination alone are insufficient. Validate minima and transition states as required by the unchanged public task. Alternative software, methods and candidate labels are permitted when the physical result is comparable. A contextual source number without an authored numeric rule creates no numerical gate. Qualitative items are independent of numeric-window passes and need their own actual computational support. An unsupported or failed item loses only its own points. Final conclusions require explicit supported inference or selection. Genuine unresolved essential physical identity/reference ambiguity requires needs_review; publication review pending alone does not block this version.
